title: Melting Dream Arch
description: A grey alien with large butterfly wings stands beside a melting clock-like table where tiny human figures gather. A classical stone archway floats in a dramatic sky above a field of dripping sunflowers, with floating blue papers scattered throughout the surreal scene.
prompt: Surreal scene featuring a tall grey alien with intricate white and gold butterfly wings standing next to a melting Dali-style clock table. Tiny human figures stand on the table. A broken classical stone arch floats in a stormy blue and black sky. Large dripping sunflowers with blue and yellow petals fill the foreground on cracked ground. Blue papers with symbols float in the air. Dark fantasy aesthetic with gold drips and melting effects.
